facts.fact: INSEED reports that in April 2026 a national workshop in Lome trained about thirty statistical-system staff to migrate datasets from Togo's existing Open Data Portal 1.0 to ODP 2.0, the national open data platform for INSEED and sector ministries; no dataset count or licence is stated.

systems.country_label: Plateforme de Donnees Ouvertes (ODP) du Togo
